13877-poise.description: A book by D. Starke. Another point presents itself here. Willpower, in order to preserve its energy, must be sustained and fixt. At this price alone can we achieve poise. arxiv-2011-07587.creator: Philippe G. LeFloch, Carlos Parés, Ernesto Pimentel-García
arxiv-2011-07587.description: Abstract For the evolution of a compressible fluid in spherical symmetry on a Schwarzschild curved background, we design a class of well-balanced numerical algorithms with first-order or second-order of accuracy. We treat both the relativistic Burgers-Schwarzschild model and the relativistic Euler-Schwarzschild model and take advantage of the explicit or implicit forms available for the stationary solutions of these models.

arxiv-2410-20707.title: DisasterQA: A Benchmark for Assessing the performance of LLMs in Disaster Response
arxiv-2410-20707.creator: Rajat Rawat
arxiv-2410-20707.description: Abstract Disasters can result in the deaths of many, making quick response times vital. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as valuable in the field. LLMs can be used to process vast amounts of textual information quickly providing situational context during a disaster. However, the question remains whether LLMs should be used for advice and decision making in a disaster.

arxiv-2412-04642.title: Improving LLM Group Fairness on Tabular Data via In-Context Learning
arxiv-2412-04642.creator: Valeriia Cherepanova, Chia-Jung Lee, Nil-Jana Akpinar, Riccardo Fogliato, Martin Andres Bertran, Michael Kearns, James Zou
arxiv-2412-04642.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be effective on tabular prediction tasks in the low-data regime, leveraging their internal knowledge and ability to learn from instructions and examples. However, LLMs can fail to generate predictions that satisfy group fairness, that is, produce equitable outcomes across groups.

arxiv-2601-18793.title: Handling Scope Checks (Extended Version) DOI: 10.1145/3776681 Journal: PACMPL Volume: 10 POPL 39 1 CCS: Software and its engineering Control structures
arxiv-2601-18793.creator: Michael Lee, Ningning Xie, Oleg Kiselyov, Jeremy Yallop
arxiv-2601-18793.description: Abstract . Metaprogramming and effect handlers interact in unexpected, and sometimes undesirable, ways. One example is scope extrusion: the generation of ill-scoped code. Scope extrusion can either be preemptively prevented, via static type systems, or retroactively detected, via dynamic checks. Static type systems exist in theory, but struggle with a range of implementation and usability problems in practice.

pmc-11354444.creator: Yang Liu, Kunliang Zou, Tonghan Wang, Minghui Guan, Haiming Duan, Haibing Yu, Degong Wu, Junli Du
pmc-11354444.description: Simple SummarySpodoptera frugiperda of the family Noctuidae in the order Lepidoptera, is native to the Americas. It is characterized by its polyphagous nature and high reproductive capacity. S. frugiperda has caused significant socio-economic losses in many countries, primarily affecting Poaceae crops such as maize, rice, wheat, and sorghum.

pmc-11462039.title: Innovation system functions: Survey data of additive manufacturing enterprises in South Africa
pmc-11462039.creator: Michelle Smit, Sara S Grobbelaar, Natasha Sacks
pmc-11462039.description: This dataset comprises survey data from South African additive manufacturing (AM) enterprises, representing approximately 80% of the industry. The survey was designed using innovation indicators from the technology innovation system (TIS) framework to explore the dynamics within South African AM enterprises. Six TIS experts and 2AM industry specialists validated the survey's comprehensiveness and relevance.

pmc-12734614.title: Early and Mid-Term Results of Solid Organ Transplantation After Circulatory Death: A 4-Year Single Centre Experience
pmc-12734614.creator: Antonella Galeone, Marilena Casartelli Liviero, Alex Borin, Rostand Emmanuel Nguefouet Momo, Leonardo Gottin, Francesco Onorati, Irene Maffei, Marco Schiavon, Paolo Persona, Tiziano Menon, Luigino Boschiero, Alessandro Antonelli, Giovanni Battista Luciani, Amedeo Carraro, Michal Nowicki
pmc-12734614.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: The use of controlled donation after circulatory death (cDCD) donors has significantly increased during the past decades and successfully expanded the donors’ pool. However, warm ischemia may have detrimental effects on graft function. Italian Law requires a no-touch period of at least 20 min, which is much longer compared to the 5 min accepted in most European countries. Materials and Methods This is an Italian single-centre retrospective review of all cDCD procedures performed from April 2021 to June 2025.

pmc-13030416.title: Immunogenicity and Protective Effects of an Ag85B Tuberculosis Subunit Vaccine Formulated with Synthetic TLR4 Agonists in BCG-Boosted Mice
pmc-13030416.creator: Soo-Min Kim, Jin-Seung Yun, EunJung Shin, Jinhee Lee, You-Jin Kim, Hye-Sook Jeong, Yong Woo Jung, Dokeun Kim
pmc-13030416.description: Background/Objectives: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major global health challenge, and the Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) vaccine has limited efficacy against adult pulmonary disease. Protein subunit vaccines are a promising alternative but require strong adjuvants to induce cell-mediated immunity. Synthetic agonists targeting toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) and stimulators of interferon genes (STINGs) have emerged as effective immunostimulants.

pmc-13037062.title: Preparedness of family caregivers for elderly patients with pressure injuries: a study of current status and predictors
pmc-13037062.creator: Jia Jia, Ya-shuang He, Qiu-yuan Wu, Yi-yuan Ren, Xiao-fen Mai, Xinfeng Huang
pmc-13037062.description: BackgroundFamily caregivers are pivotal in the care of elderly patients with pressure injuries (PIs). Their preparedness is crucial for patient outcomes, yet its determinants are not fully understood. This study aimed to assess preparedness among family caregivers of elderly PIs patients and identify its key predictors.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study in a general hospital from May 2024 to March 2025.

pmc-13114264.title: Disentangling Uric Acid and Renal Pathways in SGLT2 Inhibitor Effects After Acute Myocardial Infarction: A Retrospective Mediation Analysis
pmc-13114264.creator: Ioana Maria Suciu, Călin Muntean, Laura Gaiță, Teodora Mateoc-Sîrb, Daliborca Cristina Vlad, Bogdan Timar, Dan Gaiță
pmc-13114264.description: Background/Objectives: Sodium–glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors have demonstrated cardiovascular benefits beyond glycemic control, yet the specific biological pathways potentially linking SGLT2 inhibitor exposure to cardiovascular outcomes after acute myocardial infarction (AMI) remain incompletely characterized. Two biologically plausible pathways, serum uric acid (SUA) reduction and renal functional preservation, have been proposed, but not directly compared in a unified analytical framework.

pmc-13576237.title: Preventing lower limb injuries in women’s football: Influence of the Stop X prevention programme on jump performance and isokinetics in professional and young elite-level female football – a prospective observational cohort study
pmc-13576237.creator: Jonas Seiler, Laura Keller, Matthias Rosa, Dominik Gnädinger, Gerrit Bode, Hagen Schmal, Lisa Bode
pmc-13576237.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLower limb injuries, particularly anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and thigh injuries, are highly prevalent in women’s football, often resulting from sudden changes in direction and poor landing mechanics. Neuromuscular training is critical to address these injury risk factors.

pmc-13602859.title: Climate-related events, human mobility, and migrant health in Latin America and the Caribbean: evidence gaps and public health implications
pmc-13602859.creator: José Sandoval-Díaz, Camila Navarrete-Valladares, Báltica Cabieses, Consuelo Suazo-Muñoz
pmc-13602859.description: ObjectivesTo map the available evidence on climate-related events, human mobility, and health outcomes in migrant populations across Latin America and the Caribbean.MethodsWe conducted a structured mini review using an evidence-mapping approach to characterize the available literature. Searches were performed in BIREME/LILACS, PubMed, and Web of Science and were complemented by a manual search of the gray literature.
